description:
Files:
- lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/api.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/incoming.ex
- proposed lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/incoming/whatsapp.ex

Functional specifications:
Bind trusted channel_config_id to sink; ignore payload-supplied connector identity. Reuse State, canonical Incoming/Outgoing, Engine routing and delivery confirmation. Supply matching profile for text/files/edits/deletes/typing/reactions and audit other declared capabilities. Fail ambiguous provider-only requests. Normalize only evidenced conversation/source facts; unknown room kinds never imply membership or history access.
User requirement: reuse Telegram implementation patterns for configuration-bound ingress, canonical message normalization, agent routing and confirmed outgoing delivery; no parallel WhatsApp agent pipeline. Add direct-message and group tests: mention of the connected account triggers configured agent; no mention does not trigger reply; preserve existing capture policy independently. Test wrong-account mention, connector isolation and quoted/mentioned identities.

Tests before implementation:
- Same peer and message ID across two accounts never cross-route
- All operation types select account B despite A being first
- Spoofed connector rejected
- Disabled/wrong-provider/missing connector fails
- Existing Telegram/Mattermost regressions

Branches validated:
- incoming
- outgoing operation matrix
- ambiguous config
- unknown room
- unavailable account

Documentation:
- docs/services/channels.md
- docs/services/message-lifecycle.md
- normalization module docs

Action reuse assessment:
Extend existing JidoChatBridge/Channels Api and reuse CommunicationBridge and Engine routing; no parallel message pipeline. Canonical message plus exact config in, existing delivery/error result out. Preserve actor context and existing authorization; no new tool.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.

comments.text: Implemented exact profile propagation through shared delivery/edit/typing/reactions/profile/test/DM paths, incoming facts and self/mention promotion before Jido routing. Group agent guard requires receiving-account mention. File/delete audit: upstream capabilities are not standalone operations in current ZAQ shared bridge; no new exposure added. mix q passes; 304 focused tests pass including Telegram and shared Api/bridge regressions. External adapter stub is scoped in a synchronous delivery fixture because registry selection is application-wide; normalization tests async. Consolidated agent/E2E scenarios remain in zaq-0l7.8.

title: [zaq-0l7.4] Carry exact connector through ingress and all outgoing operations
